jurisdiction.venue: European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO — 8 Member States)

headline: In a €410 Million Smartphone ‘Carousel,’ Prosecutors Allege, Every Stop Paid Out a Tax Refund
deck: European prosecutors ran 300 dawn raids in Operation Hermes, detaining 62 suspects and executing orders to seize up to €310 million in an alleged €410 million V.A.T. carousel.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: 62 suspects detained in Portugal, Spain and Italy after searches in 8 EU member states, with orders to seize up to €310M and €9M in assets seized; investigation active, all suspects presumed innocent.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: If proven, the scheme alleged here would resemble filing a €1,650 ($1,800) fictitious sales-tax refund claim
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Audited and prosecuted locally without 300 synchronized pan-European dawn raids

sources.title: Operation Hermes: 62 Detained in €410 Million Cross-Border Smartphone VAT Fraud Investigation

interactive_art_spec.caption: European Chief Prosecutor Laura Codruța Kövesi. Operation Hermes spanned eight E.U. nations in an alleged €410 million smartphone V.A.T. loop.
